subject: Reasoning
description: Family/relationship logic including generational and coded-relation problems

questions.stem: Pointing to a man, Rita said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the man related to Rita?
questions.explanation: 'Only daughter of my mother' = Rita herself. So his mother is Rita → he is Rita's son.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: If A is the brother of B, B is the sister of C, and C is the father of D, how is D related to A?
questions.explanation: A and C are siblings (both have B as sibling). D is C's child → D is A's niece/nephew. Gender of D is not stated so the safest answer is 'niece or nephew'.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, 'I have no brother or sister, but that man's father is my father's son.' Whose photograph was it?
questions.explanation: 'My father's son' with no siblings = the man himself. So 'that man's father = the speaker' → the photograph is of the speaker's son.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: P is the brother of Q. Q is the brother of R. S is the father of P. How is R related to S?

options.option_text: Son or daughter (gender of R unknown)

questions.explanation: P, Q, R are siblings. S is P's father → S is also R's father. R's gender isn't stated, so answer: S's son or daughter.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a family, A + B means A is the mother of B; A − B means A is the brother of B; A × B means A is the father of B; A ÷ B means A is the daughter of B. Which expression shows that P is the maternal uncle of Q?
questions.explanation: Maternal uncle = mother's brother. We need P as brother of Q's mother M. P − M (P is brother of M) + M + Q (M is mother of Q) → P − M + Q. Option A captures this relation.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Introducing a woman, a man said, 'Her mother is the only daughter of my mother-in-law.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: 'Only daughter of my mother-in-law' = the man's wife. So the woman's mother is the man's wife → the woman is the man's daughter.
